readerCopy.body: One precise question can give a sensitive subject enough shape to become a conversation instead of another private loop. When Mercury sextiles Chiron, language and sensitivity cooperate, making it easier to name the part that hurt, ask what was meant, or put a missing detail in writing without retelling the entire history. The issue becomes more workable once somebody says the first clear sentence. Precision can reduce the amount of pain being generated by guessing.
